SELECT s.id, s.title, s.npc_id AS npcId, n.name AS npcName, n.icon AS npcIcon, s.`date` AS date, s.`time` AS time, s.city, s.venue, s.price, s.capacity, s.taken, s.status FROM `show` s LEFT JOIN npc n ON s.npc_id = n.id AND n.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.`date` desc

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.npc_id AS npcId, n.name AS npcName, n.icon AS npcIcon, s.`date` AS date, s.`time` AS time, s.city, s.venue, s.price, s.capacity, s.taken, s.status FROM `show` s LEFT JOIN npc n ON s.npc_id = n.id AND n.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.npc_id = #{npcId} ORDER BY s.`date` ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `show` WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('在售', '预售')
